_readme: Config for tools/pr-digest. repos is the watch list for Get-PrDigest.ps1 (owner/repo, default owner yodatech1988 if bare name given). owner_only_repos starts from OWNER_ONLY_REPOS in core/.github/workflows/claude-review.yml (2026-09-26 read, that list is hard-coded there on purpose so a caller cannot opt out) plus ops-household and family-hub, which are personal-scoped by name but not yet wired into claude-review.yml -- see aegis-automerge-policy memory. Update-BehindPrs.ps1 refuses to touch any repo in this list regardless of what a PR looks like.
